evals.expected_output: Authentication endpoint implemented with proper error handling, type hints, and JWT token generation

evals.prompt: Use the codex-invoke skill to create Pydantic models for authentication in src/api/schemas/auth.py. Include LoginRequest (email: str, password: str) and TokenResponse (access_token: str, token_type: str defaulting to 'bearer'). Add type hints.
